title: State at v0.28.2 and where the current state is recorded
summary: This article is a snapshot. The current figures are always in README.md of the project, with the version they were measured on; sweep.tsv and poke.tsv hold the per-example results.
snapshot: Natives ported: 1,157 of 1,182 (1,129 at v0.27.0; 28 added in v0.28.0: the program's own controls in a file dialog; 11 added in v0.27.0: the tab owner dialog; v0.26.0 added none, it is the release of the KDE system images; 1,098 at v0.24.0; 20 added in v0.25.0: user messages, generic notifications, up-down reply, buttons from a stem, bars made later, .Window, public routines; 65 added in v0.24.0: scroll bar, property sheet pages, date-time picker, 30 scattered; 78 added in v0.23.0: the re-bar; 74 added in v0.22.0: tool bar and custom draw; 192 added in v0.21.0; 26 of those accept their call and do nothing, 18 system metrics are fixed values). 12 of the 43 added in v0.18.0 accept their call and do nothing.
Tests: 65 of 65 pass in headless Chromium. 35 of them are upstream examples or the designer's programs, run unchanged.

Sweep of the 140 upstream examples: 84 show their dialog, 7 run to the end, 8 show only a message box, 1 stops at a native not ported, 9 stop on an error (8 of them wait for a reader of binary resources), 24 are components, 7 are outside ooDialog.

Probe at v0.19.0, 88 examples: 73 clean, 11 connect an event that is not produced, 4 with a problem, none of them in the port's own code. This run found four faults of the port in examples the sweep called shows; all four are fixed in v0.19.0.
"shows" in the sweep means a dialog appeared. It does not mean every feature of the example works. Only an example that is a test (with steps and assertions) is known to work.
done: Dialogs: UserDialog, RcDialog (.rc and .h files), ResDialog through the resource provider, ControlDialog, property sheets and wizards, owned dialogs, message boxes, standard dialogs and routines.

Controls: buttons, check boxes, radio buttons, group boxes, statics, images, edits, list boxes, combo boxes, progress bars, list-views, tree-views, tabs, up-downs, track bars, date-time pickers, month calendars.
Menus: menu bars and popup menus, from scripts and through the resource provider.
Resizing: ResizingAdmin (pin definitions, size limits, wantSizeEnded) since v0.17.0, pagedTab since v0.19.0; DlgAreaU with connectResize since v0.9.
Drawing, bitmap buttons and animation, the Mouse class, in-place editing in a list-view (edit, drop-down list, editable combo box), list box tab stops, fonts.
Tool tips since v0.18.0: tools that are windows or rectangles, fixed and asked text, NEEDTEXT SHOW POP RELAY, ToolInfo, manageAtypicalTool, a tree-view's getToolTips with GETINFOTIP.

Printing since v0.20.0: oodPrint.cls makes a PDF with the estate's oorexx_pdf and the page hands it to the user (Print, Open, Save). A list-view as a table, a text, a report of the program, any file. Not checked in a real browser.

Since v0.21.0: LvItem, LvSubItem, LvFullRow and the list-view methods on them, with sortItems; the StatusBar control; windows by handle (getWindowText, setWindowText, showWindow, sendMessageToControl, sendMessageToWindow); a control's connectKeyPress; the dialog's backgroundColor; item data of a combo box; the old addXxx names of the create methods; SM, SPI, OS, DlgUtil's arithmetic.

Since v0.22.0: the ToolBar control and TbButton (text buttons; images are kept, not drawn); custom draw of a list-view and a tree-view (customDrawControl, LvCustomDrawSimple, TvCustomDrawSimple); the tree-view's sortChildrenCB; the tree-view's itemInfo answers a stem as upstream.

Since v0.23.0: the ReBar control and ReBarBandInfo (bands that hold other controls; the user cannot drag a band); a dialog whose place puts part of it outside the window is moved in, also when the window changes size.

Since v0.24.0: the ScrollBar control and its events; property sheet pages added, inserted and removed while it is open, pressButton, apply, the wizard buttons; the date-time picker's range; tool tip margins and colours are drawn; getItemRect of a tab, hitTestInfo of a list box, modifyColumnPx of a list-view, key2name, getAsyncKeyState, childWindowFromPoint, getComboBoxInfo. Probe at v0.24.0, 91 examples: 74 clean, 12 connect an event that is not produced, 5 with a problem outside the port's own code.

Since v0.25.0: addUserMsg (WM_COMMAND, WM_SIZE, WM_MOVE, and any message the program sends itself), addUserSubclass, connectNotifyEvent (CLICK DBLCLK ENTER RCLICK GOTFOCUS LOSTFOCUS), deltaPosReply, createPushButtonStem, createToolBarWindow and its two sisters, .Window~new(handle), findWindow, simpleFolderBrowse, .Image~toID. Probe at v0.25.0, 90 examples: 74 clean, 12 connect an event that is not produced, 4 with a problem outside the port's own code.

Since v0.26.0: KDE Breeze icons stand for the system images of Windows. .Image~getImage and .Image~fromIDs answer them for the IDI_, OIC_ and OBM_ numbers and symbols, and a message box shows them. The map is src/kde-icons.map; the files are in src/kde with their LGPL licence text; tools/oodkde.rex takes them from a clone of KDE/breeze-icons.

Since v0.27.0: the tab owner dialog: TabOwnerDialog, ManagedTab, TabOwnerDlgInfo, ControlDlgInfo. A UserDialog owner with UserControlDialog pages is tested. An owner started from a resource does not start its tabs yet. The upstream example TabOwnerDemo.rex shows its owner and stops at its pages: they come from a TabOwnerDemo.dll that is not in the source tree.

Since v0.28.0: CommonDialogCustomizations: check buttons, combo boxes, edit boxes, menus, push buttons, radio button lists, separators, texts and the Open button's own list inside an Open or Save dialog, with their values and notices. The file dialog is an ooDialog dialog written in Rexx (OodFileDialog in src/oodExtras.cls), so a renderer needs nothing new for it. Probe at v0.28.0, 92 examples: 74 clean, 12 connect an event that is not produced, 6 with a problem outside the port's own code.

v0.28.1: the demo page was tested by Josep Maria Blasco with real pointer and keyboard events in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, and at phone width with touch: the seventeen samples open with no console errors, and with ooRexx/WASM runtime trunk r13564 they give the same output as with 0.2.4. He reported three faults of the page, corrected in v0.28.1.

v0.28.2: the port on ooRexx/WASM 0.2.5. No code of the port changed. To move a copy from 0.2.4 to 0.2.5, replace seven files with those of oorexxwasm-web-0.2.5.zip: ooRexx.js, ooRexx-worker.js, rexx.js, rexx.wasm, rexx.data, js-realm.js, polygon-clipping.umd.min.js. rexx.data grows from 1.8 MB to 5.6 MB: it now carries the Rexx Parser (parser.cls). The 65 tests, the demo check of 17 samples and the sweep of 140 examples give the same results on both runtimes.
File dialogs and shell dialogs over the WASM machine's file system.
not_done: 25 natives: ResourceImage (7, needs the reader of binary resources), CategoryDialog (4, deprecated upstream), upstream's debugging hooks (11), and lv_zTest, dimBitmap, MonthCalendar getGridInfo.
Tracking tool tips. Images in list-views, tool bars and status bars. Dragging a re-bar band.
ControlDlgInfo and the tab owner dialogs.
connectActivate, connectHelp, connectPosChanged, connectResizing (accepted, not produced).
Image-list icons are not drawn; ResourceImage needs images from a binary resource.
The CommonDialogCustomizations controls of the shell dialogs.
Printing of dialog fields and drawings; the print panel is not checked in a real browser.
Not run on a real phone or on the public Playground; the demo page is not hosted.
invariants: When this article and README.md disagree, README.md is right and this article needs a new version.
A feature is listed as done only when a test with assertions covers it.
